Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: umi-juanlopez
Message:
release(onca): the counter release — tables, KDS, payments and the production cut

Everything the café needs to open, in one revision. The till, the API, the
dashboard and the migrations that carry them to production.

POS: Cuentas with Lista/Mapa, a table map with states and "crear mesa nueva",
a compact KDS with per-station sounds and overdue colours, the comanda showing
each line's kitchen state ("En cola", "Preparando", "Listo"), push to the
waiter's handheld, sequential split payments over one account, bank transfer
with the café's details, the tap-to-pay glyph as SVG, printer and drawer as
independent channels, and a daily account number that starts at 001 and never
crosses the 04:00 boundary.

API: contract 2.38.1, the forward migrations 001..040, the push outbox, the
kitchen routes and the checkout policy the till reads.

Dashboard: kitchen routing with per-product overrides, target and overdue
times, sounds, staff with an email for PIN access, and the hardware centre.

Three house rules needed repair to pass the gates: the migrations 029, 033 and
035 opened their own transaction (the caller owns it), the error-code guard
learned FCM_NOT_CONFIGURED and VALIDATION_ERROR, and the pos-cash regression
spec now pins the exit that keeps a half-closed drawer in reconciliation.

release(onca): the counter release — tables, KDS, payments and the production cut

Everything the café needs to open, in one revision. The till, the API, the
dashboard and the migrations that carry them to production.

POS: Cuentas with Lista/Mapa, a table map with states and "crear mesa nueva",
a compact KDS with per-station sounds and overdue colours, the comanda showing
each line's kitchen state ("En cola", "Preparando", "Listo"), push to the
waiter's handheld, sequential split payments over one account, bank transfer
with the café's details, the tap-to-pay glyph as SVG, printer and drawer as
independent channels, and a daily account number that starts at 001 and never
crosses the 04:00 boundary.

API: contract 2.38.1, the forward migrations 001..040, the push outbox, the
kitchen routes and the checkout policy the till reads.

Dashboard: kitchen routing with per-product overrides, target and overdue
times, sounds, staff with an email for PIN access, and the hardware centre.

Three house rules needed repair to pass the gates: the migrations 029, 033 and
035 opened their own transaction (the caller owns it), the error-code guard
learned FCM_NOT_CONFIGURED and VALIDATION_ERROR, and the pos-cash regression
spec now pins the exit that keeps a half-closed drawer in reconciliation.

dashboard and the migrations that carry them to production.

POS: Cuentas with Lista/Mapa, a table map with states and "crear mesa nueva",
a compact KDS with per-station sounds and overdue colours, the comanda showing
each line's kitchen state ("En cola", "Preparando", "Listo"), push to the
waiter's handheld, sequential split payments over one account, bank transfer
with the café's details, the tap-to-pay glyph as SVG, printer and drawer as
independent channels, and a daily account number that starts at 001 and never
crosses the 04:00 boundary.

API: contract 2.38.1, the forward migrations 001..040, the push outbox, the
kitchen routes and the checkout policy the till reads.

Dashboard: kitchen routing with per-product overrides, target and overdue
times, sounds, staff with an email for PIN access, and the hardware centre.

Three house rules needed repair to pass the gates: the migrations 029, 033 and
035 opened their own transaction (the caller owns it), the error-code guard
learned FCM_NOT_CONFIGURED and VALIDATION_ERROR, and the pos-cash regression
spec now pins the exit that keeps a half-closed drawer in reconciliation.

Message:
release(onca): the counter release — tables, KDS, payments and the production cut

Everything the café needs to open, in one revision. The till, the API, the
dashboard and the migrations that carry them to production.

POS: Cuentas with Lista/Mapa, a table map with states and "crear mesa nueva",
a compact KDS with per-station sounds and overdue colours, the comanda showing
each line's kitchen state ("En cola", "Preparando", "Listo"), push to the
waiter's handheld, sequential split payments over one account, bank transfer
with the café's details, the tap-to-pay glyph as SVG, printer and drawer as
independent channels, and a daily account number that starts at 001 and never
crosses the 04:00 boundary.

API: contract 2.38.1, the forward migrations 001..040, the push outbox, the
kitchen routes and the checkout policy the till reads.

Dashboard: kitchen routing with per-product overrides, target and overdue
times, sounds, staff with an email for PIN access, and the hardware centre.

Three house rules needed repair to pass the gates: the migrations 029, 033 and
035 opened their own transaction (the caller owns it), the error-code guard
learned FCM_NOT_CONFIGURED and VALIDATION_ERROR, and the pos-cash regression
spec now pins the exit that keeps a half-closed drawer in reconciliation.
